Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，A location phrase normally comes before the main action verb. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，装作 must be followed by an action phrase to express pretending to do that action. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他小的时候，The first mention should introduce the character with a full noun phrase and name; later in the same scene, use a pronoun for the already introduced character. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun when the same character was mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing referent is present. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is one completed move at age five, so the separable verb needs 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作“玩”之前，改为“在墓地里玩”正确。
“装祭拜”不完整，但“装作祭拜”仍不如“装着祭拜的样子”或“装作在祭拜”自然、完整。
人物首次出现应先作适当介绍，再用“他”指回孟子。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按该参考规则这里应改用近指代词“他”。
五岁时搬家是已完成的一次事件，离合词应说“搬了家”。
